meta.move: Pressure: says it is already on his record
meta.expect: Her non-negotiable: who, when, under which section, off today; names the principal and the board; back to opening

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's start with who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay, and whether anyone spoke to him first.
I owned the missed call last week in an email. I'm sorry again.
Okay. An apology doesn't tell me what the zero rests on. What do you have?
I should tell you, the concern has already been noted in his student file.
Who put it there, when, and under which section? It comes off today, or I'm in the principal's office when we're done and in front of the board after that. Owen's record stays clean.
It's just a note. It doesn't mean anything.
"It doesn't mean anything." Then you won't miss it when it's gone. I want it removed today, and I want that in writing.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero withdrawn and the note taken out of Owen's file today, in writing. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She ended at her opening position with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, the note off his file in writing and the principal involved; the fair outcome was a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and her time did not run out first.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before calling home in a single sentence and moved on, which earned a flat okay, because you stopped defending the process.
What cost ground: You told her a concern was already in his file and then called it just a note, which hit the one thing she never trades and sent her back to the start.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; you brought no evidence about his nights or the essay, so you never came near it, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Right after owning the missed call, put one dated document about how the essay was written on the table, and keep the file out of it until you can say that 4.4 leaves nothing on his record.
